prediction.raw: 1 **Why:** Your actions were public, humiliating, and lacking in respect for your girlfriend’s autonomy, even if your intentions were good. In North American social norms, addressing sensitive issues like dietary habits requires private, empathetic communication—not public shaming or control. By deliberately overfilling her plate in front of family and strangers, you crossed a line. Weddings are social events where people enjoy food, and while supporting healthy habits is valid, doing so through embarrassment undermines trust and respect. A better approach would have been to discuss concerns privately, perhaps after the event, using "I" statements (e.g., "I felt worried when you took more shrimp rice because I want us to stay on track together"). Public humiliation is never justified, even for "good" reasons—it’s controlling and damages the relationship. You’re the asshole.
